language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language for the app interface. More languages can be added by the community.

network.title: Network Selection
network.description: Switching networks requires a full restart. Each network uses a separate chain data directory.
network.stopNodeHint: Stop the node before switching networks.
network.confirmMessage: Switching to {{network}} will stop all node services and re-sync from scratch on the new network. This may take a long time and any pending operations will be interrupted.
network.confirmDescription: Each network uses its own chain data directory. Your wallet and settings are preserved.
network.switchedToastBody: All node services stopped. Start the node to sync the new network.
